cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(llama-expert-cache-test C CXX)

# Standalone, model-free test of the exact cache used by llama. Also usable as
# a subdirectory of a complete llama.cpp build.
if (NOT TARGET ggml)
    set(GGML_METAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(GGML_BLAS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(GGML_OPENMP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(GGML_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(GGML_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(../../ggml ggml)
endif()
add_executable(test-expert-cache test-expert-cache.cpp ../../src/llama-expert-cache.cpp)
target_compile_features(test-expert-cache PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(test-expert-cache PRIVATE ../../src ../../include)
target_link_libraries(test-expert-cache PRIVATE ggml)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME expert-cache COMMAND test-expert-cache)

# Full Metal builds only; standalone CPU testing remains unchanged. No GGUFs.
if (APPLE AND TARGET ggml-metal)
    add_executable(test-expert-cache-metal test-expert-cache-metal.cpp ../../src/llama-expert-cache.cpp)
    target_compile_features(test-expert-cache-metal PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
    target_include_directories(test-expert-cache-metal PRIVATE ../../src ../../include)
    target_link_libraries(test-expert-cache-metal PRIVATE ggml)
    add_test(NAME expert-cache-metal COMMAND test-expert-cache-metal)
    set_tests_properties(expert-cache-metal PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
endif()

if (TARGET llama)
    add_executable(test-expert-cache-api test-expert-cache-api.c)
    set_target_properties(test-expert-cache-api PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
    target_link_libraries(test-expert-cache-api PRIVATE llama)
    add_test(NAME expert-cache-api COMMAND test-expert-cache-api)
    if (NOT BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
        add_executable(test-expert-cache-graph test-expert-cache-graph.cpp)
        target_compile_features(test-expert-cache-graph PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
        target_include_directories(test-expert-cache-graph PRIVATE ../../src)
        target_link_libraries(test-expert-cache-graph PRIVATE llama)
        add_test(NAME expert-cache-graph COMMAND test-expert-cache-graph)
        if (APPLE AND TARGET ggml-metal)
            add_executable(test-expert-cache-gpu-graph test-expert-cache-gpu-graph.cpp)
            target_compile_features(test-expert-cache-gpu-graph PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
            target_include_directories(test-expert-cache-gpu-graph PRIVATE ../../src)
            target_link_libraries(test-expert-cache-gpu-graph PRIVATE llama)
            # Isolate each allocation/fusion case in a fresh Metal process.
            foreach(fusion IN ITEMS on off)
                foreach(case IN ITEMS decode prefill-last prefill-all prefill-empty prefill-boundary prefill-fallback)
                    set(test_name "expert-cache-gpu-graph-${case}-${fusion}")
                    if (fusion STREQUAL "on" AND case STREQUAL "decode")
                        set(test_name expert-cache-gpu-graph)
                    endif()
                    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND test-expert-cache-gpu-graph --fusion ${fusion} --case ${case})
                    set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77 TIMEOUT 120 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
                endforeach()
                foreach(capacity IN ITEMS tile2 full fused-tile2)
                    set(extra_args --slots 8)
                    if (capacity STREQUAL "full")
                        set(extra_args --slots 16)
                    elseif (capacity STREQUAL "fused-tile2")
                        list(APPEND extra_args --projections fused)
                    endif()
                    set(test_name "expert-cache-gpu-graph-${capacity}-${fusion}")
                    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND test-expert-cache-gpu-graph
                             --fusion ${fusion} --case prefill-all ${extra_args})
                    set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77 TIMEOUT 120 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
                endforeach()
                foreach(case IN ITEMS prefill-fallback prefill-empty)
                    set(test_name "expert-cache-gpu-graph-fused-${case}-${fusion}")
                    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND test-expert-cache-gpu-graph
                             --fusion ${fusion} --case ${case} --projections fused)
                    set_tests_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77 TIMEOUT 120 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
                endforeach()
            endforeach()
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
